steps.title: Start the review
steps.prompt: Run "Start review": the alert shows as in review, under your name.

steps.title: Read what triggered the alert
steps.prompt: Read both of these fields of this alert (every one is needed): "Alert · Rule" and "Alert · Score and time": the rule that fired and what it looks for, the score and when it fired.

steps.title: Compare with the declared profile
steps.prompt: Read all 4 of these fields of this alert (every one is needed): "Customer · Declared profile", "Customer · Expected each month", "Customer · Activity against declared" and "Customer · Risk and KYC": the job or business the customer declared, the money in and out they said to expect each month, the last 30 days against it, and their risk rating and KYC.

steps.title: Read the alert's transactions
steps.prompt: Read all 4 of these fields of this alert (every one is needed): "Transactions · Summary", "Transactions · Counterparties", "Transactions · Countries" and "Transactions · Money in, money out": how many and how much (and the largest), who paid or was paid, which countries, and how fast the money in left again.

steps.title: Check the customer's history
steps.prompt: Read both of these fields of this alert (every one is needed): "History · Earlier alerts" and "History · Investigations": earlier alerts on this customer and how they ended, and any investigation.

steps.title: Does the profile explain it?
steps.prompt: Explained when what the customer declared accounts for the money: a bonus from their own employer, a company's usual clients or suppliers. Not explained when money passes through to strangers or abroad, or lands just under a threshold. Not sure: ask a senior.

steps.title: Send for a second look
steps.prompt: Run "Send for a second look" and say what you are unsure about: the alert leaves the AML queue and waits for a senior.

steps.title: Read why the analyst asks
steps.prompt: Read the field "Result · Outcome" of this alert: who sent it for a second look, and why.

steps.title: Senior review
steps.prompt: You take over from the analyst: read the "Customer ·", "Transactions ·" and "History ·" lines above, then write in one or two sentences why you clear or escalate.

steps.title: Clear or escalate?
steps.prompt: Your decision, as the senior analyst.

steps.title: Clear the alert
steps.prompt: Run "Clear alert": the reason and the note are pre-filled; say what explains the money. The result card sums up the decision.

steps.title: Escalate to an investigation
steps.prompt: Run "Escalate": it opens an investigation with the alert's transactions, or adds them to the customer's open one. The result card names the investigation, new or already open, and the transactions it holds.
